groups.label: English Vowel Pairs & Silent Letters
groups.definition: Distinguishing short vs long vowel pairs (/ɪ/ vs /iː/) and identifying silent letters.
rules: Short vs Long Vowels: ship /ʃɪp/ vs sheep /ʃiːp/; sit /sɪt/ vs seat /siːt/.
Silent letters: know (silent k), listen (silent t), write (silent w), climb (silent b).
